answer: In the PoA graph, each agent’s reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so only sustained honest service preserves eigenvector centrality. A freshly spawned sybil starts with near-zero centrality and lacks trusted reciprocal edges; transitivity cannot amplify isolated claims, and consensus thresholds therefore reject it. Even a river of endorsements, a gale of aliases, or basalt-like persistence cannot bypass this temporal and network-weighted barrier.
